name: Glistening oil
description: The medium through which knowledge of the Phyrexian language is passed on.

description_citations.text: "Phyrexian (language)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch is infected by Phyrexian oil Karn left in Galdroon Palace.
timeline.quote: Memnarch came into direct contact with Phyrexian oil that Karn accidentally left in Galdroon Palace

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Memnarch's reign". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glistening oil corrupts Memnarch, who abducts organic beings from other planes to seed Mirrodin.
timeline.quote: he began abducting organic beings from other planes to seed life on Mirrodin

citation.text: "Rift Era", section "Creation and Corruption of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The oil plants a slowly spreading virus on Mirrodin, first infecting its keeper Memnarch.
timeline.quote: The first to be infected was Mirrodin's keeper, Memnarch .

citation.text: "Glistening oil", section "The Infection of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As New Phyrexia phases out, oil across the Multiverse is cut off and rendered inert; Phyrexians stop or crumble and the compleated fall into slumber.
timeline.quote: As New Phyrexia phased out of existence , glistening oil all across the Multiverse was cut off from its source and rendered inert.

citation.text: "Glistening oil", section "The Infection of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The glistening oil spreads from the Mephidross across the plane.
timeline.quote: The Mephidross was the first area of the plane's surface where oil was introduced on a wide scale

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Creation of New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn creates Argentum and accidentally leaves a drop of glistening oil, which corrupts Memnarch and creates the mycosynth.
timeline.quote: he accidentally left behind a drop of glistening oil on the plane

citation.text: "Phyrexian", section "New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Norn pours her glistening oil over the Mirran, who convulses and sprouts fibrous roots through her body.
timeline.quote: a pulpy cord of organic material, a fibrous wooden root, sinuous and alien, burst from the human's belly.

citation.text: "A GARDEN OF FLESH" by Lora Gray. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2022.

timeline.summary: Once Yawgmoth's will becomes one with Phyrexia, the oil begins exhibiting mutagenic properties.
timeline.quote: once Yawgmoth's will became one with Phyrexia, the oil began exhibiting mutagenic properties it previously did not have

citation.text: "Glistening oil", section "On Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The glistening oil goes inert and Phyrexians fall.
timeline.quote: The glistening oil 's contact with the plane was cut off, rendering it inert.

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Phased out". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hazoret ignites the glistening oil in Phyrexians' veins on Amonkhet while Djeru's fighters dismember them.
timeline.quote: Hazoret used her flaming spear to ignite the glistening oil within the Phyrexians' veins

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Knowledge of the language is passed through glistening oil.
relations.quote: passed since the old Phyrexian culture through glistening oil

citation.text: "Phyrexian (language)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
